## 7. Budget reallocation what-if (illustrative, 180-day matured cohort)

Cut 30% of spend from paid acquisition campaigns with LTV:CAC < 2.0 (Search - Generic, Spark Ads, Influencer Collab) and move it to the best scalable ones (Shopping, Lookalike, Prospecting). Brand search and email welcome are excluded as receivers (volume is demand-capped, not budget-capped).

- Budget moved: 102,973 TRY
- Profit given up by acquiring fewer customers in cut campaigns: 65,325 TRY

Net profit change depends on how efficiently the extra spend converts (diminishing returns):

| Efficiency of extra spend | Net profit change (TRY) |
|---|---|
| 40% of historical | -53,943 |
| 60% of historical | +3,235 |
| 80% of historical | +60,413 |
| 100% of historical | +117,590 |

_Scenario, not a forecast: it covers the matured 180-day cohort only and assumes the stated efficiency._
